name: Ember Brief
summary: A fast tool briefing: a dark dotted field over the speaker in the bottom half, an illustrated title, graphics that act each idea out on its words (a link that connects, a race, a figure that fills) beside real page captures, two-word captions with the spoken word in magenta, and a comment call to action.
bestFor: news takes with a source to show
solo talking-head briefings of 30 to 45 seconds
